delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal model submission bound to local transport response capture and matching successful request receipt; not archive union or proof of semantic use.

selection.summary: Issue #12333 asks to document the hydration behaviour of `{@html}` and `` (server value wins; dev-time warning) and add a test. Delivered evidence covers the runtime side: packages/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/blocks/html.js (where `w.hydration_html_changed` is invoked during hydration when the server-rendered HTML differs from the client value) and packages/svelte/src/internal/client/warnings.js (definition of the `hydration_html_changed` warning message). No documentation files or hydration test samples were delivered in this phase, so the docs update and new test could not be patched or verified; only this relevant runtime context is selected, with no claims of a verified repair.
